title: Replace logo with uploaded token image without modifications

requirements.text: Replace the current logo on the login page with the uploaded token image (IMG_8398-1.png) displayed without any frame, border, or modifications

quotes: Bitte nur das Foto den Token als Logo ohne Rahmen und Veränderungen einbinden

acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded token image is displayed as the logo on the login page
No frame, border, background, or visual modifications are applied to the token image
